description: This file provides Mac-specific API functions for the FreeType project, including functions to create font faces from Mac resources and file specifications.

methods.name: FT_New_Face_From_FOND
methods.description: Creates a new font face object from a Mac FOND resource.

methods.name: FT_GetFile_From_Mac_Name
methods.description: Retrieves an FSSpec for a font file given its Mac OS name.

methods.name: FT_New_Face_From_FSSpec
methods.description: Creates a new font face object from a resource and typeface index using an FSSpec.
